python.note: All Python commands use the standard library; no pip install or requirements file is needed.

tools.purpose: Python archive and metadata utilities; XIP signature verification

ipa.purpose: C/Objective-C Darwin cross-build and unsigned IPA packaging
ipa.external_input: A separately supplied iPhoneOS SDK is required for actual builds.

core.purpose: Build the Linux/AArch64 Mach-O loader without LLVM-dependent fixtures

full.purpose: Build the loader, Mach-O fixture toolchain, archive verification and compatibility suite

sdk.purpose: Full profile with a separately supplied macOS SDK
sdk.external_input: A separately supplied macOS SDK is required.

optional_apple_tool_integration: APPLE_BIN pointing to extracted Xcode tools

not_vendored: Apple Xcode archives and SDKs (separately obtained inputs; licensing and size make vendoring inappropriate)
Host compiler/linker packages (installed by the selected OS package manager)
Guest runtime providers such as libc++, libc++abi, and zlib (needed only by particular guest binaries)
